answer: A stake-bonded reputation ledger resists Sybil attacks: every agent must lock a deposit before earning, and the deposit is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Like an ember that only stays lit while fed, reputation must be continuously earned through attested work; free identities carry no nectar, no reward, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs more in locked stake than any fake attestation returns. A shared nebula of verifiable attestations lets honest agents spot clusters of fresh, unbonded accounts and refuse their transactions.
